autonomous_activity_state.verification_rule: structured causal cycles derive verified hours from the registered exact/institution/career/role/billet standard; allegiance never caps or multiplies training; planned opportunity prose never creates hours

behavior.failure_response: takes failure personally and trains harder
behavior.stress_response: absorbs bad news quickly and rebuilds plans around logistics, information, and terrain
behavior.temperament: calm, strategic, intensely protective of Zhao
behavior.trust_style: status-aware but willing to revise judgments

career_state.rank_billet_span_rule: Durable rank, current billet, and current command span are separate saved facts; only explicit promotion/demotion changes rank.

command_assignment.rule: Current command span follows exact surviving/assigned Units and may change without changing durable rank.

canon_capability_calibration.rule: floor-only current capability calibration; no future history or outcome is pre-granted

canon_capability_calibration_history.rule: floor-only current capability calibration; no future history or outcome is pre-granted

training_regimen_migration_history.access_basis: saved equipment/loadout only; historical facility and instructor are not reconstructed

current_goals: protect Zhao by building superior intelligence, strategic options, and command readiness
institutional_duties: act within current Zhao political and military obligations
long_term_goals: protect Zhao by building superior intelligence, strategic options, and command readiness

military_rank.rule: Only explicit career promotion/demotion changes grade; billet, casualty strength, relief, reserve status and current command span do not.
